CustomField.label: How checks appear
CustomField.description: Cosmetic only. Controls whether all check rows are listed up front or built up as the run advances. Show all checks at once lists every eligible check on load (pending), then fills in each result in place. Reveal checks one at a time shows no rows until the run starts, then adds each check as it is reached. Same checks, same order, same outcomes either way. It does not change when checks run (that is the Start Checks field).

value.label: Reveal checks one at a time

CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show all checks at once = every eligible check is listed on load (pending) and fills in its result. Reveal checks one at a time = no rows on load; each check appears as the run reaches it.
